Specification: This module is a smoke-test harness specification that orchestrates repeated TLC simulations of another specification, SmokeEWD998.tla, and records outcomes to a CSV file. It defines a CSV filename using the current Java time, writes the CSV header at startup via an ASSUME statement, constructs a Java command line for invoking TLC, and then uses a quantified ASSUME to execute many nested runs over combinations of bug flags and random process counts. The module is not itself a transition-system specification with variables or temporal behavior; instead, it is a scripting-style TLA+ model that uses IOUtils, CSV, and TLC operators to drive external execution, classify exit codes such as assumption, invariant, and property violations, and log them.
AssumptionNames:
\A i \in 1..30 : \A bf \in SUBSET (1..6) : Cardinality(bf) # 1 \/
    LET ret == IOEnvExec([BF |-> bf, Out |-> CSVFile, PN |-> RandomElement(3..4)], Cmd)
    IN /\  CASE ret.exitValue =  0 -> PrintT(<<JavaTime, bf>>)
             [] ret.exitValue = 10 -> PrintT(<<bf, "Assumption violation">>)
             [] ret.exitValue = 12 -> PrintT(<<bf, "Invariant violation (Inv)">>)
             [] ret.exitValue = 13 -> PrintT(<<bf, "Property violation (TDSpec)">>)
             [] OTHER    -> PrintT(ret)
       /\  CSVWrite("%1$s#%2$s", <<bf, ret.exitValue>>, CSVFile)
CaseExpr:
CASE ret.exitValue =  0 -> PrintT(<<JavaTime, bf>>)
             [] ret.exitValue = 10 -> PrintT(<<bf, "Assumption violation">>)
             [] ret.exitValue = 12 -> PrintT(<<bf, "Invariant violation (Inv)">>)
             [] ret.exitValue = 13 -> PrintT(<<bf, "Property violation (TDSpec)">>)
             [] OTHER    -> PrintT(ret)
FunctionApplication: IOEnvExec([BF |-> bf, Out |-> CSVFile, PN |-> RandomElement(3..4)], Cmd)
